snippet.title: True Confession | First Trailer! #trailer #gameplay #pixelart #indiegame #game #gaming #oldschool
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4544200/True_Confession/

This is the first trailer of True Confession - dramatic pixel art shooter.

True Confession is a game aimed at fans of action movies 80-00 years (Heat, Training Day, The Wire, The Departured). In visual and gameplay style resembles postal plus, crimsonland, gta2, hotline miami, hong kong massacre. The game is oldschool but seasoned with modern mechanics and deep religious and psychological plot.

Henry Hughes tormented by nightmares, in which he dreams of gunfights and murders. Henry is a religious man and he is frightened by the attraction of anger and hatred that he experiences in his dreams - with these feelings he goes to the pastor and consults with him.

It covers the topics of crime in the streets,  emotions, religion, psychoanalysis, alcoholism, unemployment and so on.
